summary: ORIX Corporation filed an extraordinary report with Japan's Kanto Financial Bureau under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act, disclosing voting results from its 63rd Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held June 23, 2026. Resolutions included amendments to articles of incorporation regarding business purposes and virtual-only meetings, along with election of ten directors, all approved by requisite majorities. This is a routine post-meeting filing common for Japanese issuers, equivalent to a Form 8-K Item 5.07 for US companies. No special-situation event—such as acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer—is present.
